purpose: Spatial QA of participant-supplied BB branch coordinates; no source points edited.

method.inside: Point covered by declared IBGE municipality polygon (boundary inclusive).
method.nearBoundary: Outside declared municipality polygon, within 1000 approximate meters from boundary.
method.outside: Outside declared municipality polygon and more than 1000 approximate meters from boundary.
method.distance: Local equirectangular projection centered at point, spherical Earth radius 6371008.8m. Distances approximate, sufficient for a 1km QA buffer.
method.uf: Point covered by declared UF polygon from current public map.

limitations: Municipal polygons are IBGE qualidade=minima and generalized; near-boundary points require caution.
Spatial containment verifies municipality, not exact street entrance or rooftop position.
Coordinates were supplied by Banco do Brasil; not independently surveyed.
nearBoundary marks a tolerance, not confirmed municipal containment.

UF and municipality polygons have different generalization; two municipal-inside points classify in neighboring UF on the coarser public UF mesh. Retain both QA results rather than treating UF polygons as higher-accuracy truth.
